svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.chicken-external-side-profile", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Compare a hen-like domestic-chicken model with this left-facing side-body diagram. It has one eye,a comb,upright fan tail and one near folded wing;the far eye/wing are hidden. Two shanks and feet attach below the belly. Feet are schematically opened with three forward and one rear toe per selected four-toed example. Hock bends are ankle-level,not backward human knees. Wattle and feather texture are omitted in this restricted form lesson;breed/sex classification and universal toe counts are not claimed. Physical exploration and recognition remain pending.", "geometry_exception": "Swell/ViewPlus share1.4mm contour and limb/toe strokes and1.2mm eye points. Index uses1.2mm native graphic dots on the same logical parts with explicit3.1mm junction/spacing guards. Feet are schematically opened as documented. All alternatives in this same master;no exact source reconstruction.", "physical_evaluation": "pending", "viewplus_shading_revision": {"date": "2026-11-06", "fill": "#808080", "purpose": "Distinguish the animal body from the unraised background using a lower grey area beneath its unchanged black outline and anatomical features; no coat pattern or pictorial shadow.", "geometry_changed": false, "physical_testing": "pending", "human_review_of_revision": "pending"}}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots,not Braille. Essential endpoints,roots and contacts are retained;optional interior candidates closer than3.1mm are omitted. One logical point at each joint;eye is a single isolated dot. Physical continuity remains pending.

use.data-design-purpose: Distinguish the animal body from the unraised background using a lower grey area beneath its unchanged black outline and anatomical features; no coat pattern or pictorial shadow.
